_meta.description: Curated offline CVE dataset for SentryScan's Vulnerability Assessment Module. Not exhaustive -- intended for lab/demo use. Extend as needed.
_meta.source: Compiled from public NVD/MITRE CVE records

records.description: vsftpd 2.3.4 contains a backdoor that opens a shell on port 6200 when a specific login string is used.
ProFTPD mod_copy allows remote command execution via SITE CPFR/CPTO without authentication.
Path traversal and remote code execution in Apache HTTP Server 2.4.49 via crafted URI path.
Apache Struts/Tomcat Jakarta Multipart parser allows remote code execution via crafted Content-Type header.
Apache Tomcat JSP upload via PUT allows remote code execution when readonly init param is disabled.
EternalBlue: SMBv1 remote code execution via crafted packets (MS17-010 / WannaCry).
SambaCry: remote code execution by uploading a shared library to a writable share.
Buffer overflow in Samba trans2open allows remote code execution.
BlueKeep: RDP remote code execution via crafted requests prior to authentication.
OpenSSH allows remote attackers to enumerate valid usernames via crafted authentication requests.
OpenSSH client roaming feature leaks private keys to a malicious server.
Heartbleed: OpenSSL heartbeat extension buffer over-read discloses process memory (keys, credentials).
PHP-CGI query string parameter injection leads to remote code execution.
Drupalgeddon2: remote code execution via crafted form API render arrays.
Redis Lua sandbox escape on Debian/Ubuntu packages allows remote code execution.
Redis instance reachable without authentication (no `requirepass` configured). Allows full data read/write and potential RCE via module loading.
Elasticsearch instance reachable without authentication, exposing indexed data via REST API.
Telnet transmits credentials and data in plaintext; any traffic can be captured by a network observer.
FTP service may allow anonymous or plaintext-credential logins; verify access controls.
Log4Shell: JNDI lookup in Log4j allows remote code execution via crafted log messages.
Shellshock: Bash processes trailing commands in function definitions from environment variables.
Ghostcat: Tomcat AJP connector allows file read/inclusion, potentially leading to RCE.
SMBv2 negotiation vulnerability allows remote code execution or denial of service.
MySQL yaSSL buffer overflow allows remote code execution via crafted packets.
